description: This file contains unit tests for the LoginLogService in the OrangeHRM authentication system, specifically testing login logging functionalities such as saving login logs and handling OIDC logins.

classes.name: LoginLogServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LoginLogService functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LoginLogService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetLoginLogDao
methods.description: Tests that the getLoginLogDao method of LoginService returns an instance of LoginLogDao.

methods.name: testSaveLoginLog
methods.description: Tests the process of saving a login log, including mocking dependencies and verifying the log details.

methods.name: testAddOIDCLogin
methods.description: Tests adding a login log for an OIDC login, checking that the login log is correctly created and populated.
